PROGRAM_LEDGER.rule: Main declares canonical architecture, active frontiers, project state and global decisions.

DEVELOPMENT_HARNESS.rule: Harness owns Work Orders, checkpoint state, evidence/review routing and runtime-worker authorization; WB/OPS must not absorb development control.

IDENTITY_SESSION_FABRIC.rule: Accounts, principals and sessions are independent from network peers and world entities.

AUTHORIZATION_POLICY_FABRIC.rule: Authorization returns policy decisions; domain owners retain semantic validation and execution.

REFERENCE_FRAME_FABRIC.rule: Reference-frame identity/transforms do not imply authority routing or spatial ownership.

TIME_FABRIC.rule: Simulation time and domain ticks are distinct from wall, network and presentation clocks.

SPATIAL_DOMAIN_FABRIC.rule: WorldAddress maps to domain spatial identities without collapsing them into a universal ChunkId.

MATERIAL_ONTOLOGY.rule: MaterialDefinitionId is shared identity; render/domain projections remain separate and domain-owned.

WORLD_TRANSACTION_MODEL.rule: WorldOperation/WorldTransactionPlan compile to existing M0 atomic commit semantics; WT is not a second coordinator.

WORLD_QUERY_FABRIC.rule: WorldQuery plans actor-scoped reads through adapters and owns no canonical database.

WORLD_LIFECYCLE_FABRIC.rule: Promotion/dormancy/demotion changes simulation resolution while preserving canonical identity and domain truth.

WORLD_WORK_BUDGET.rule: Work budgets choose quality/defer/dispatch policy and never imply authority, canonical ownership or development authorization.

SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY_GOVERNANCE.rule: Schema/protocol/content/migration versions are explicit; domain owners retain domain migration semantics.

SECURITY_TRUST_BOUNDARIES.rule: Security adds validation, secrecy and abuse controls without redefining gameplay truth.

ITEM_IDENTITY_AND_GRAPH.rule: Item owns permanent Item identities and Item Graph semantics.

MATTER_TRUTH.rule: Matter owns authoritative mutable material/volume truth and durable Matter transactions.

GEO_PROCEDURAL_BASELINE.rule: World Generation owns deterministic procedural baseline and Geo feature/field contracts.

EVOLUTIONARY_ECOLOGY_RESEARCH.rule: ECO owns evolutionary ecology research semantics and later controlled adapters; it does not own economy/market accounting or production scheduling.

WORLD_ECONOMY.rule: ECON owns future market/contracts/economy semantics and consumes physical Item/MAT/WT truth without duplicate resource accounting.

AUTHORITY_FOUNDATION.rule: Authority leases/epochs/routing remain separate from identity, frames, cells and compute assignment.

NETWORK_REPLICATION_POLICY.rule: Network owns transport/replication policy, not gameplay truth or global work scheduling.

PERSISTENCE_DURABILITY.rule: Async I/O must preserve accepted commit/replay/recovery semantics.

DERIVED_PRESENTATION.rule: Renderer/HLOD/rig/mesh/replica artifacts are disposable derived representations.

COMPUTE_EXECUTION.rule: Workers compute proposals; authority validates and commits.

CELESTIAL_DYNAMICS.rule: SP owns celestial motion providers; RF owns frame identity/transforms.

ENVIRONMENT_SIMULATION.rule: ENV owns atmosphere/thermal/fluid rules while using MAT/TF/SD/WB foundations.

HIERARCHICAL_NAVIGATION.rule: NAV consumes WQ/SD/RF and does not own world state.

ACTOR_AI_RUNTIME.rule: AI consumes WQ/AUTHZ/WT and never receives direct canonical-store write access.

POPULATION_FIELD.rule: Population aggregates use LIFE/TF/WB and promote selected actors without duplicate identity.

ORGANIZATION_SEMANTICS.rule: Organization claims are semantic world state and never equal server shards or render chunks.

WORLD_CLUSTER_OPERATIONS.rule: Operations observes and invokes existing control APIs; it is not canonical world truth and does not own the development harness.

MOD_EXTENSION_MODEL.rule: Mods provide definitions/providers/proposals and cannot bypass canonical validation/authority.

mandatory_intersections.rule: session continuity never redefines actor identity
frame identity never implies authority route
simulation time never becomes work scheduler
one material identity; projections remain domain-owned
compile to M0; never create a second transaction engine
development dispatch/checkpoint authorization remains separate from runtime work budgeting and cluster operations
human and AI actors converge on the same WorldOperation path
